description:
Perform an internal link audit for a specific product page using Screaming Frog SEO Spider. 

STEPS:
1. Crawl 'https://books.toscrape.com/'.
2. Locate the product page for 'A Light in the Attic' (URL ends in .../a-light-in-the-attic_1000/index.html).
3. Select this URL in the main window to populate the bottom details panel.
4. Navigate to the 'Inlinks' tab in the bottom panel to view incoming links.
5. Export ONLY this list of inlinks to a CSV file named 'attic_inlinks.csv' in the '~/Documents/SEO/exports/' directory.

SUCCESS CRITERIA: A CSV file must exist containing the 'From', 'To', and 'Anchor Text' columns for links pointing specifically to the 'A Light in the Attic' page.
